'''Drendek''' were large lizards native to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] that was home to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]].<ref name="abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>
